associations.rationale: The formal type identifies the scalar extension of V along a finite extension with a power of V indexed by the extension degree, supplying the restriction-of-scalars step of the stated argument.

The formal type packages the finite-extension consequence that an equivalence after base change implies V and W are A-linearly equivalent, without itself stating the power-identification and cancellation argument.
The formal type states cancellation from an A-linear equivalence between positive finite powers of V and W to an A-linear equivalence V ≃ W, providing the cancellation step.
